title: Quick start wizard
heading: Make a lyric video
needSong: Add at least the audio or the lyrics
previewHint: Every step shows up right away in the preview on the left

song.intro: Just drag in the song and its lyrics — you can drop both files anywhere in the window at once. Lyrics alone are enough to start; add the audio later.
song.fiaTip: Listened to this song in folia? Export it from folia's Import / Export Lyrics (or "Export current lyrics as .fia" in its command palette) as <file>.fia</file> and drag it in: it is folia's lossless format, so word timing, translations and the segmentation you saved in folia come along unchanged.
song.coverDone: Used for theme colors and backgrounds
song.coverHint: A cover embedded in the audio is used automatically
song.title: Title
song.titlePlaceholder: Shown in the opening and credits

style.aiDone_one: The AI arranged {{count}} section from the lyrics
style.aiDone_other: The AI arranged {{count}} sections from the lyrics
style.title: Visual style
style.mixHint: Big compositions for choruses and breaks, kinetic type for verses, a new style for each section.
style.aiDirected: Styles were picked for each section by the AI.
style.aiHint: Let the AI read the lyrics and pick a style and transition for every section.

assets.intro: Have character art, illustrations or a logo? Add them and they are placed on the frame shot by shot. Transparent PNGs work best. If you have none, just go on.
assets.explain: Images take turns shot by shot and change with the shot: character art alternates left and right, sliding in from its side; wide images go in the middle. You can adjust each one later on the timeline or in the inspector.

theme.defaultHint: Black, white and orange — fits any song
theme.coverMissing: Add a cover in the first step
theme.randomHint: Roll the dice for a random, harmonious palette
theme.aiMissing: Set up a provider in the AI side bar first
theme.aiBack: {{name}} · click to switch back to it
theme.aiHint: Colors from the mood of the lyrics, with keyword colors too
theme.openEditor: Want to fine-tune every color, keyword and icon? Open the theme editor

done.tip1: Right-click a section or shot on the timeline to change its style or transition, or to split and merge sections.
done.tip2: The same lyrics and seed always produce the same video; try another seed in Look & Arrangement for a different arrangement.
done.tip3: Every change can be undone (Ctrl+Z), and the project saves automatically.

empty.closeHint: Close (you can open the wizard later from Quick Start in the title bar)
empty.title: Make a lyric video
empty.body: Add a song and its lyrics, pick a style and colors — a finished video in a few steps.
empty.drop: Or just drag audio and lyrics files into the window
